title: Bigelow's survival essay contest and Mishlove's winning essay
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Bigelow's survival essay contest and Mishlove's winning essay, about 2020s (COVID era) at Nevada, USA, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
